properties.name: triggers
properties.title: Triggers
properties.description: One row for each push button wired between a GPIO pin (BCM number) and ground, and what pressing it does: play, stop, toggle (stop while playing, else play), next (the next page of the playlist), run a task (a Priority Update task, set up on the row, that shows for its minutes) or play a playlist (the playlist layer goes to its first track and carries on from there). Play, stop, toggle and next can each be on one button only. Not a pin the panel uses (the list says which). Changes apply within a few seconds.

properties.name: pin
properties.title: GPIO Pin
properties.description: The GPIO number (BCM) the button is wired to: the choices follow the display type chosen in Display, and the pins the panel uses are not available.

properties.name: action
properties.title: Action
properties.description: What pressing the button does. A task shows a Priority Update (its settings are set on the row) for its minutes. Play playlist starts the playlist you choose from its first track.

properties.name: playlist
properties.title: Playlist
properties.description: The playlist the button starts: it begins at its first track and carries on from there, through the playlists after it.

properties.name: ledPin
properties.title: LED Pin
properties.description: The GPIO number (BCM) of an LED wired from the pin through a resistor to ground; the Inky Impression has one on 13, at the top centre edge of the board. Empty: no LED. Not a pin the panel or a button uses. Its patterns say at once what the panel takes half a minute to show.

properties.name: ledPress
properties.title: On a Press
properties.description: What the LED does when a button is pressed: played once. Test plays the pattern chosen now, on the LED of the saved pin.

properties.name: ledLongPress
properties.title: On a Long Press
properties.description: What the LED does when a button is held for a second: played once.

properties.name: ledDrawing
properties.title: While Drawing
properties.description: What the LED does while the panel refreshes (about half a minute): played until the panel is done. A press plays over it.

properties.name: ledProblem
properties.title: On a Problem
properties.description: What the LED does while something needs a look: every track of the playlist failed, or the device is waiting to be set up. Played until it is dealt with; it comes before Drawing.

properties.name: ledSpeed
properties.title: Speed
properties.description: How long one blink takes, on and off: every pattern speeds up or slows down with it, keeping its rhythm. Slower is easier to see from across a room. Test plays three blinks at the speed chosen now; the Tests beside the patterns use the saved speed.

properties.name: ledQuietFrom
properties.title: Quiet From
properties.description: The hour (0 to 23, the device's time) the LED goes dark, for the night; it lights again at Quiet To. Either empty: never dark. A Test still plays.

properties.name: ledQuietTo
properties.title: Quiet To
properties.description: The hour (0 to 23) the LED lights again after Quiet From: 22 to 7 is dark from ten at night to seven in the morning.
